meaning:
γλωσσόκομον, -ου, τό, vernac. form of cl. γλωσσοκομεῖον
(γλῶσσα, κομέω), [in LXX for אָרוֹן, 2Ki.6:11, 2Ch.24:8, 10 11 * ;]
1. = cl. -εῖον (see supr.), a case for holding the reeds or tongues of musical instruments.
2. As in LXX, π. (MM, see word), a box, chest: Jhn.12:6 13:29.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
